Implementation Plan

## Implementation plan: run the peer check on continuation dispatches unless the synchronize run is gate-skipped

Planning ref: `orchestrator/project-7490` @ `8a5ad60c7f7ac77b950a4670d0cac81cc061043a` (the integration branch matches, so no mismatch). Refs #7490.

Scope-mode: Hold Scope
Reuse-audit: extends autofix_retrigger_has_inflight_peer
Scope-mode justification: The issue names the exact change: one script, one existing test file, a few lines in one runbook section, and one changelog and one agents fragment. The fix only changes the condition on the existing bypass, so that the existing peer check (`autofix_retrigger_has_inflight_peer` in `scripts/gh_helpers.sh`, already used by the non-continuation path) also runs for continuation dispatches when the synchronize run is a real review run. There is no new helper, variable, log prefix or API call. The complete version (rewritten comment, an exact `continuation=true` skip line, and tests for all four cases plus "helper missing") costs well under 30 extra lines compared with only changing the condition, so it is the chosen option. By §6 Core Priorities (Security > Correctness & safety > Backward compatibility > Operational clarity > Performance > Speed), correctness comes first: no redundant runs in the `pr-autofix-<PR>` group, and still always a successor run. Backward compatibility comes next: every existing log key and variable is unchanged.

### What the code does today (verified on this ref)
- `scripts/review_autofix_step_post_commit_retrigger.sh` (193 lines):
  - Lines 61-75 set `is_continuation_dispatch=true` for a productive autofix when continuation is on.
  - Lines 85-91 wait `peer_wait` (`AUTOFIX_RETRIGGER_PEER_WAIT_SECS`, clamped 0..60, default 8).
  - Lines 93-110 hold the comment and the bypass: `if [ "${is_continuation_dispatch}" = "true" ]; then echo "AUTOFIX_PEER_CHECK_BYPASSED ..."; elif type autofix_retrigger_has_inflight_peer ... && autofix_retrigger_has_inflight_peer "${PR_NUMBER}" "${TARGET_BRANCH}" "${CURRENT_RUN_ID}"; then echo "AUTOFIX_DISPATCH_SKIPPED reason=sync_event_inflight ..."; emit_event ...; exit 0; fi`.
  - Lines 112-119 print the dispatch-issued log lines, and lines 121-187 are the #4898 default-branch dispatch chain.
- `scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:276` applies the self-trigger skip only when `"${AUTOFIX_SKIP_SELF_TRIGGERED:-false}" = "true"`. The comment at line 267 confirms the default is `false`. The issue's premise holds.
- The `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` step "Re-trigger review via workflow_dispatch" (line 4723) already passes `AUTOFIX_SKIP_SELF_TRIGGERED: ${{ vars.AUTOFIX_SKIP_SELF_TRIGGERED }}` in its `env:` (line 4748). No workflow edit is needed; the PR description should say so (an unset repo variable becomes `""`, which the script's `:-false` treats as `false`).
- No test pins the old bypass wording or `AUTOFIX_PEER_CHECK_BYPASSED`. `tests/test_retrigger_default_branch_dispatch.py` has an `_run_script` harness:
  - a recording `gh` function;
  - an empty `SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR`;
  - `HARNESS_PRELUDE` for stubbing probes;
  - `extra_env` overrides;
  - defaults to the legacy path (`DID_COMMIT=false`, `CONFLICT_RESOLVED=true`).

## Files likely to change
- `scripts/review_autofix_step_post_commit_retrigger.sh`
- `tests/test_retrigger_default_branch_dispatch.py`
- `probably_unnecessary_but_read_if_stuck.md`
- `changelog.d/wfopt-2026-09-20-2-continuation-peer-check.md`
- `agents.d/wfopt-2026-09-20-2-continuation-peer-check.md`

## Functions or modules to implement

1. **`scripts/review_autofix_step_post_commit_retrigger.sh`**, replacing only the comment and the `if/elif` block at lines 93-110:
   ```
   if [ "${is_continuation_dispatch}" = "true" ] \
     && [ "${AUTOFIX_SKIP_SELF_TRIGGERED:-false}" = "true" ]; then
     echo "AUTOFIX_PEER_CHECK_BYPASSED pr=... current_run=... reason=continuation_dispatch source=post_commit_retrigger"   # unchanged text
   elif type autofix_retrigger_has_inflight_peer >/dev/null 2>&1 \
     && autofix_retrigger_has_inflight_peer "${PR_NUMBER}" "${TARGET_BRANCH}" "${CURRENT_RUN_ID}"; then
     if [ "${is_continuation_dispatch}" = "true" ]; then
       echo "AUTOFIX_DISPATCH_SKIPPED reason=sync_event_inflight pr=${PR_NUMBER} current_run=${CURRENT_RUN_ID} source=post_commit_retrigger continuation=true"
       emit_event "AUTOFIX_DISPATCH_SKIPPED" "reason=sync_event_inflight" "pr=${PR_NUMBER}" "current_run=${CURRENT_RUN_ID}" "source=post_commit_retrigger" "continuation=true"
     else
       <existing echo + emit_event lines, byte-identical>
     fi
     exit 0
   fi
   ```
   - The dispatch-issued block (lines 112-119), the #4898 chain, the sleeps, the clamps and every variable name stay unchanged.
   - Rewrite the comment above the block so it says:
     - The continuation bypass applies only when `AUTOFIX_SKIP_SELF_TRIGGERED=true`. Only then does the gate skip the synchronize run our push created (`AUTOFIX_GATE_SKIP reason=self_triggered_autofix`), so that run can never be the successor.
     - Under the default (`false`), the synchronize run is a real review run in the same `pr-autofix-<PR>` concurrency group (`cancel-in-progress: false`). The continuation therefore runs the peer check and skips with `reason=sync_event_inflight ... continuation=true` when a peer is found.
     - The peer check fails open. If no peer is seen, the probe fails, or the helper is missing, the continuation still dispatches, so a missing synchronize event still gets a successor run.
     - Cite the five redundant pairs in the source doc, for example cancelled run 35466085922 next to successful run 35466097830.

2. **`tests/test_retrigger_default_branch_dispatch.py`**: add a "continuation peer check" section that reuses `_run_script(POST_COMMIT_SCRIPT, ...)`.
   - Continuation env: `DID_COMMIT=true`, `CONFLICT_RESOLVED=false`, `LEDGER_ONLY_COMMIT=false`, `AUTOFIX_CONTINUATION_SETTLE_SECS=1`, `AUTOFIX_RETRIGGER_PEER_WAIT_SECS=0` (already the harness default).
   - Caller ref: `.../internal-review.yml@refs/heads/main`, with `succeed_on="internal-review.yml"`.
   - Stub the peer probe as `autofix_retrigger_has_inflight_peer() { echo "PEER_ARGS $*"; return 0|1; }` and record `emit_event` arguments (D2).
   - Tests:
     - `test_continuation_skips_when_sync_peer_inflight_by_default`: skip-self unset, peer returns 0. Expect exit 0, no `workflow run` call, a stdout line `AUTOFIX_DISPATCH_SKIPPED reason=sync_event_inflight pr=4898 current_run=36500000000 source=post_commit_retrigger continuation=true`, no `AUTOFIX_PEER_CHECK_BYPASSED`, and probe arguments `PR BRANCH CURRENT_RUN`.
     - `test_continuation_dispatches_when_no_peer_by_default`: peer returns 1. Expect one dispatch to `internal-review.yml`, plus `AUTOFIX_CONTINUATION_DISPATCH_ISSUED` and `AUTOFIX_DISPATCH_ISSUED reason=no_peer_detected ... continuation=true`.
     - `test_continuation_dispatches_when_peer_check_unavailable`: no stub defined. Expect a dispatch (fail-open).
     - `test_continuation_bypasses_peer_check_when_skip_self_triggered`: `AUTOFIX_SKIP_SELF_TRIGGERED=true`, peer returns 0. Expect `AUTOFIX_PEER_CHECK_BYPASSED ... reason=continuation_dispatch`, a dispatch, and the probe never called (no `PEER_ARGS`).
     - `test_non_continuation_peer_dedup_unchanged`: legacy defaults, peer returns 0. Expect no dispatch, the skip line exactly as before, with no `continuation=true` and no bypass line. Also run it with peer returns 1 and expect a dispatch with the unchanged `AUTOFIX_DISPATCH_ISSUED reason=no_peer_detected ...` line that has no `continuation=` key.
   - The file is already wired into CI, so no new test file and no wiring change.

3. **`probably_unnecessary_but_read_if_stuck.md` §20.4**: edit only the two bullets at lines 429-430 (the `AUTOFIX_CONTINUATION_DISPATCH_ISSUED` and `AUTOFIX_PEER_CHECK_BYPASSED` bullets).
   - Change the bypass statement to the corrected condition: bypass only when `AUTOFIX_SKIP_SELF_TRIGGERED=true`; otherwise the continuation runs `autofix_retrigger_has_inflight_peer` and skips with `AUTOFIX_DISPATCH_SKIPPED reason=sync_event_inflight ... continuation=true`, failing open to the dispatch.
   - Add one bullet for the new `continuation=true` skip variant.
   - Do not reflow the rest of the section.

4. **`changelog.d/wfopt-2026-09-20-2-continuation-peer-check.md`**: a `<!-- changelog: fixed -->` fragment written in the voice of the existing fragments. It states:
   - the problem: a redundant second review run that waited 31-159 minutes;
   - the new rule;
   - what it means for operators: one review run per productive autofix push under the default settings, and no change when `AUTOFIX_SKIP_SELF_TRIGGERED=true`.

5. **`agents.d/wfopt-2026-09-20-2-continuation-peer-check.md`**: one block starting `<!-- agents: section="Review pipeline consolidator + ledger contract" -->`. It is one bullet with the rule, the log lines (`AUTOFIX_PEER_CHECK_BYPASSED reason=continuation_dispatch` only with skip-self true; `AUTOFIX_DISPATCH_SKIPPED reason=sync_event_inflight ... continuation=true` otherwise), and the fail-open behaviour. `AUTOFIX_DISPATCH_SKIPPED` is already a registered log prefix, so no new prefix entry is needed.

## Data structures affected
None. No state, schema, marker or env-var changes. `continuation=true` already exists as a key/value on `AUTOFIX_DISPATCH_ISSUED`; this adds it to `AUTOFIX_DISPATCH_SKIPPED`, the same way `continuation_enabled=` was added before.

## API or interface changes
- **Log lines:** one new variant of an existing prefix, `AUTOFIX_DISPATCH_SKIPPED reason=sync_event_inflight ... source=post_commit_retrigger continuation=true`.
- **Bypass line:** `AUTOFIX_PEER_CHECK_BYPASSED` keeps its text but now appears only when `AUTOFIX_SKIP_SELF_TRIGGERED=true`.
- **GitHub API:** a continuation run now makes the same peer-check calls the legacy path already makes, about 1-2 `actions/runs` reads with the existing pagination. It is no longer a bypass. I
